description: This file defines an enum 'KeychainStore' with static methods to load, save, and delete string values from the keychain. It acts as a wrapper around 'GenericPasswordKeychainStore' for keychain operations.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Loads a string from the keychain for the given service and account.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string to the keychain for the given service and account.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a keychain item for the given service and account.
